question_record.context: A security incident involving a possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files was reported. The user account dropped a ransomware-related file on several devices, including the host `vnevado-win11t`. The file names involved were `get-userprttoken.ps1`, `characterical.zip`, and `characterical.zip.lockbit`. Automated remediation actions may be taken to disable the compromised account.
question_record.question: A ransomware payload was remotely launched on another device. Can you identify the host name of this second device where the ransomware payload was launched?
solution: A user account with SID `S-1-5-21-1840191660-8534830288-125585561-1522` was observed dropping ransomware-related files on several devices.
A ransomware payload was remotely launched on the host `vnevado-win11u`.

93.name: Possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files
93.description: A user account was observed dropping a ransomware-related file on several devices. An attacker may have compromised the said user account to move laterally across the network and infect as many devices with ransomware as possible. Automated remediation action may be taken to disable the account.

139.name: Ransomware payload remotely launched.
139.description: A ransomware payload was remotely launched on this device. Attackers might be attempting to encrypt content on this device, rendering it unusable to users. For more information, read the Threat Analytics report, Threat overview: Human-operated ransomware: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/05658b6c-dc62-496d-ad3c-c6a795a33c27/analystreport

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_SID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
